text: The Dragon Dance INPUT is fully held in a 650-line UI class nobody in this packet opened. DragonDanceUI builds an eight-node ring (node0..node7) labelled with the eight trigrams in two arrangements — Earlier Heaven ['sky','wind','water','mountain','earth','thunder','fire','lake'] and Later Heaven ['fire','earth','lake','sky','water','mountain','thunder','wind']. The player's input is a DIGIT STRING of clicked node indices. Earlier Heaven completes on a 4-length sequence containing nodes 1, 2, 4 and 6, which promotes the ring to Later Heaven. Validation is a string equality against the target object's sequence. The Kanji statue is Obj_DragonDanceStatue, whose Later-Heaven target sequence is drawn from five fixed permutations by a node-seeded deterministic RNG.
